title: AssistantConversationSummaryResponse
description: List-item shape of GET /api/assistant-conversations (HEL-663) and the response body of POST /api/assistant-conversations/:id/messages and PATCH /api/assistant-conversations/:id -- deliberately compact, no transcript (design.md D5). The list itself is ordered pinned DESC, updatedAt DESC and defaults to at most the 10 most recent (pinned-first) conversations when no explicit limit is requested -- a route-local default distinct from this codebase's shared page-size default (200).
